args.fix: Added FOR UPDATE row lock to the balance SELECT in withdraw(), so concurrent withdrawals on the same account serialize on the row lock; check-and-debit becomes atomic while unrelated accounts remain independent.
args.root_cause: Time-of-check-to-time-of-use race: withdraw() did SELECT balance then UPDATE balance in READ COMMITTED without locking the row, so N concurrent withdrawals could all read the same pre-withdrawal balance, all pass the `balance >= amount` check, and all debit — driving no-overdraft accounts negative.

text: Fix accepted. Root cause was TOCTOU race in `withdraw`: plain `SELECT balance` without a row lock let concurrent withdrawals all pass the check then all debit. Fix adds `FOR UPDATE` to serialize same-account withdrawals.
